name: FLA_ACCRUAL_SCHEDULES
description: FLA_ACCRUAL_SCHEDULES contains period wise accural interest, amortization and lease expense.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: ACCRUAL_SCHEDULE_ID. This is the Primary key column.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Schedule header identifier from FLA_SCHEDULE_HEADERS.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_START_DATE
columns.description: Accrual Start Date. Start date of accural period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DATE
columns.description: Schedule date. End date of the accrual period.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accrual period in which accrual falls in.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ACCRUAL_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days between accural start and end date

columns.name: PERIOD_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Period Remainder. It is used in lease expense calculation of periodic calculation frequency.

columns.name: INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest amount for the accrual period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE1_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual Schedule amount for schedule 1.

columns.name: SCHEDULE1_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual amount remainder leftover for current period due to the rounding logic. This should be included in the next period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE2_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual schedule amount for schedule 2.

columns.name: SCHEDULE2_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual amount remainder leftover for current period due to the rounding logic. This should be included in the next period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE3_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual schedule amount for schedule 3.

columns.name: SCHEDULE3_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual amount remainder leftover for current period due to the rounding logic. This should be included in the next period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE4_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual schedule amount for schedule 4.

columns.name: SCHEDULE4_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual amount remainder leftover for current period due to the rounding logic. This should be included in the next period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE5_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual schedule amount for schedule 5.

columns.name: SCHEDULE5_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accrual amount remainder leftover for current period due to the rounding logic. This should be included in the next period.

columns.name: OPENING_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Financial ROU opening balance as of period start date.

columns.name: CLOSING_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Financial ROU closing balance as of period end date

columns.name: OPENING_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Operating ROU opening balance as of period start date.

columns.name: CLOSING_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Operating ROU closing balance as of period end date

columns.name: GENERATED_FROM_AMEND_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if schedule is geneated due to an amendment.

columns.name: ACCRUED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if schedules are accrued or not.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this accrual is reversed, in case if amendment comencement date is earlier than latest accrual period.

columns.name: CATCHUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if schedules are generated for catchup purpose.

columns.name: READ_IN_DRAFT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record was considered for generation of accrual schedules in the draft lease.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version of the schedule generation.

columns.name: SCHEDULES_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier for the schedules generation batch.

columns.name: EXPIRED_ROU_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the right of use has expired because of an impairment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Attribute indicating the payment for which the accruals is being calculated.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASES_ALL table to indicate that the liability schedules are pertaining to specific lease.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
